featured_reviews.name: Lal Kishor Prasad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mira Road fish market is a great place to buy fresh and affordable seafood in Mumbai. The market is well-organized and clean, and the staff are friendly and knowledgeable about the various types of fish available. They offer a wide selection of seafood, including fish, prawns, crabs, and lobsters, all of which are fresh and of high quality.

One of the things I love about this fish market is the variety of fish available. They have everything from pomfret to mackerel to kingfish and more. The prices are reasonable, and you can even bargain with the vendors to get a better deal.

Overall, if you're looking for a reliable place to buy fresh seafood in Mumbai, Mira Road fish market is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!
